entities.name: PJA1 Praja-1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Mus musculus UniProt O55176; 578 aa.
E2-dependent E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase that ubiquitinates MAGED1, promoting proteasomal degradation.
Binds ubiquitin-conjugating enzymes including UBE2D2; reviewed annotation places it in the cytoplasm.
Contains a C-terminal RING-type zinc-finger region at residues 530–571, supported by Pfam zf-RING_2 and zf-C3HC4 scans.
N-terminal residues 1–298 and region 332–397 are annotated as intrinsically disordered; sequence is low-complexity, acidic/basic, and likely regulatory.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight 63,905 Da, theoretical pI 4.878, GRAVY −0.895, charge at pH 7 approximately −33.4, instability index 70.9.

entities.name: MAGED1
observations: Mouse Praja-1 is annotated to ubiquitinate MAGED1, leading to proteasomal degradation.

entities.name: UBE2D2
observations: Praja-1 is annotated to interact with the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UBE2D2.
